primary_scope: Explain the real bank cash movement: exact amount, direction and supported nature, party or specific instrument; invoice/partita identity and current residual are separate.
deterministic_evidence: Explicit nonempty reference and party identity in both qualified source populations; same currency/unit/entity and signed direction; exact cents; complete unconflicted reference group; no duplicate source signatures. Amount/date alone never qualifies.
allocation_rule: Candidate examination is not allocation. Only a supported exact cash relationship reserves its source rows; invoice closure requires its independent domain allocation controls.
secondary_scope: Supported account-level explanation; never infer invoice closure, current residual or TeamSystem partita identity from an internal number or assumed key.
